title: Arrhenius kinetics comparing catalyst activation energies
what: activation energy Ea (kJ/mol) of Cat-Pt, Cat-Ni, or their difference

reader_questions.question: What is the primary quantitative finding or value?
reader_questions.expected: Cat-Pt has Ea = 53.1 kJ/mol vs Cat-Ni Ea = 84.7 kJ/mol (a 31.6 kJ/mol lower barrier).

reader_questions.question: Is the difference clearly outside uncertainty or noise?
reader_questions.expected: Yes; triplicate scatter is tight (~5.5% CV) around both Arrhenius lines, separating the slopes cleanly.

reader_questions.question: What caveat, outlier, control, or subgroup pattern matters?
reader_questions.expected: Because Cat-Ni has a steeper slope (higher pre-exponential factor), its rate approaches Cat-Pt at the 625 K high-T end.
